mapper.sql: select t.type_id, t.subject_id, t.type_code, t.type_name, t.sort, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, s.subject_name from spas_subject_question_type t left join spas_subject s on s.subject_id = t.subject_id
mapper.select: where t.subject_id = #{subjectId} and t.status = '0' order by t.sort asc, t.type_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from spas_subject_question_type where type_id in #{id}
